def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    rems = inputs.get('REMS', inputs.get('rems', inputs.get('remainders', inputs.get('residues'))))
    mods = inputs.get('MODS', inputs.get('mods', inputs.get('moduli')))
    x = 0
    product = 1
    for remainder, modulus in zip(rems, mods):
        modulus = int(modulus)
        remainder = int(remainder) % modulus
        adjustment = ((remainder - x) * pow(product, -1, modulus)) % modulus
        x += product * adjustment
        product *= modulus
        x %= product
    return x

{"code":"def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    M = inputs.get('M', inputs.get('matrix'))
    exponent = inputs.get('power', inputs.get('exponent', inputs.get('n')))
    modulus = inputs.get('modulus', inputs.get('mod', inputs.get('m')))
    A = [[int(M[0][0]) % modulus, int(M[0][1]) % modulus],
         [int(M[1][0]) % modulus, int(M[1][1]) % modulus]]
    R = [[1, 0], [0, 1]]
    def mul(X, Y):
        return [[(X[0][0]*Y[0][0] + X[0][1]*Y[1][0]) % modulus,
                 (X[0][0]*Y[0][1] + X[0][1]*Y[1][1]) % modulus],
                [(X[1][0]*Y[0][0] + X[1][1]*Y[1][0]) % modulus,
                 (X[1][0]*Y[0][1] + X[1][1]*Y[1][1]) % modulus]]
    e = int(exponent)
    while e:
        if e & 1:
            R = mul(R, A)
        A = mul(A, A)
        e >>= 1
    return sum(map(sum, R))"}
